d: A shocking incident was reported at a Pune court when a murder accused, who had arrived for a court hearing, was brutally attacked by unidentified assailants. According to reports, the attackers allegedly opened fire and attacked the accused with sharp weapons, severing his hands. The incident triggered panic and raised serious questions about security arrangements at the court premises. The attackers reportedly fled the scene after carrying out the assault.
